sec.title: August 27 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 218)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 27** across American and international network radio, Alonzo Deen Cole's chilling Aztec curse in *The Witch's Tale*, Paul Whiteman on *The Philco Radio Hall of Fame*, Jack Moyles in *A Man Named Jordan*, and three distinct eras of *The Rudy Vallee Show* (1931 Fleischmann's Yeast with Ray Perkins, 1936 with Mary Boland, and 1942 Sealtest with Eugene Pallette & Xavier Cugat) (1931–1950):
